pillars.title: Multimodal Intelligence
pillars.description: Vision-language learning, fine-grained multimodal retrieval, and structured reasoning over visual and textual evidence.

pillars.title: Reliable AI
pillars.description: Robust retrieval, evidence verification, uncertainty calibration, and selective decision rules for systems that know when evidence is insufficient.

pillars.title: Structured Reasoning
pillars.description: Constraint-aware retrieval, decomposition, debate, and formal decision protocols for complex language tasks.

emerging_directions: Healthcare AI - extending reliable multimodal methods to healthcare applications.
Reliable AI - building systems that can calibrate uncertainty and defer when evidence is insufficient.
Neuro-symbolic AI - combining learned representations with explicit reasoning and verification.
